emitted_output_order.rule: A3 locally dominates A1 only if preservation_failure, reject, repair, changed-character/span and identifiable-operation coordinates are all non-worse, with at least one strict improvement.
emitted_output_order.incomparable: Any crossing of authority-bearing coordinates yields INCOMPARABLE; no weights are introduced.

action_interpretation.ACCEPT: zero observed human repair under this evaluator/task; not correctness gold
action_interpretation.REPAIR: nonzero local repair supplied; not proof that original was universally wrong
action_interpretation.REJECT: surface judged unsuitable for local repair under frozen task; not population-quality gold
action_interpretation.ABSTAIN: system emitted no candidate; separate coverage/fallback debt, not zero burden

aggregate_rule: Report paired win/tie/loss/incomparable counts by lane.
Report ACCEPT/REPAIR/REJECT counts and repair-footprint distributions separately.
Do not condition system-level success only on emitted A3 outputs.
Owner-local promotion requires preservation noninferiority and no task-family sign destruction.
latent_burden: R2 time/effort/cognitive burden remains HOLD unless exact instrumentation is acquired.
